items.exampleEn: There was a big audience at the game.
Giving red envelopes is a Chinese New Year tradition.
items.exampleZh: 發紅包是農曆新年的傳統。

items.exampleEn: The editor found three mistakes in my story.
items.exampleZh: 編輯在我的故事裡找到三個錯誤。

items.exampleEn: Please use a white background for your photo.
items.exampleZh: 你的照片請用白色背景。

items.exampleEn: We visited the science museum on Sunday.
items.exampleZh: 我們星期天去參觀了科學博物館。

items.exampleEn: Look at the ratings before you buy.
The old temple has six red columns.
items.exampleZh: 那座老廟有六根紅色柱子。

items.exampleEn: TV was our only entertainment in the village.
items.exampleZh: 在村子裡，電視是我們唯一的娛樂。

items.exampleEn: We saw a dinosaur exhibition at the museum.
items.exampleZh: 我們在博物館看了一場恐龍展覽。

items.sentenceEn: The museum is free on the first Sunday of every month.
items.sentenceZh: 博物館每個月第一個星期日免費參觀。

items.audioEn: The art exhibition will stay open until the end of May.
items.audioZh: 這場藝術展覽會一直展到五月底。
items.questionZh: 展覽會開放到什麼時候？

items.sentenceEn: The audience laughed at the funny scene.
items.sentenceZh: 觀眾被那個好笑的場面逗笑了。

items.sentenceEn: This restaurant has a high rating online.
items.sentenceZh: 這家餐廳在網路上的評分很高。

items.stemEn: She writes a weekly ____ about food for the newspaper.
items.stemZh: 她每週為報紙寫一篇美食專欄。

items.stemEn: In our family, it's a ____ to eat cake on birthdays.
items.stemZh: 在我們家，生日吃蛋糕是一個傳統。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, our town museum opened a new exhibition about old photos. A famous photographer showed pictures of our town from fifty years ago. In many photos, you can see the old train station in the background. The museum also had music and other entertainment for children. My uncle, an editor at the local newspaper, wrote about it in his column. He gave the exhibition a five-star rating.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我們鎮上的博物館推出了一個關於老照片的新展覽。一位有名的攝影師展出五十年前我們小鎮的照片。很多照片的背景裡都看得到舊火車站。博物館還為小朋友準備了音樂和其他娛樂活動。我叔叔是地方報紙的編輯，他在自己的專欄裡寫了這個展覽，還給了五顆星的評分。

questions.questionZh: 叔叔給這個展覽幾顆星？

rubricZh: 「很受歡迎」可寫例如 very popular

items.instructionZh: 用 entertainment 造一個句子，說說你最喜歡的娛樂。
referenceEn: Watching movies is my favorite entertainment.
For me, music is the best entertainment.
rubricZh: entertainment 是不可數名詞（例如 a lot of entertainment）
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 Watching movies is）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：題目要「說說你最喜歡的娛樂」，參考答案 "This city has a lot of entertainment for young people." 沒有說到自己最喜歡的娛樂，不符題目要求。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "For me, music is the best entertainment."（原 "This city has a lot of entertainment for young people."）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關：正解選項明顯是最長的一個（"Until the end of May" 20 字元 vs 10–11），違反「正解不落在最長集合」；應縮短正解或加長干擾項。
